message: Upgrade to vg-paradigms release 2026.10.10 (No CI unless a project is open to contributions (closed by default, none open): rule ci.contributors-only, no rendered workflows, CI-only checks before a release), by your auto subscription: its dry run broke nothing

title: Baseline release 2026.10.10: render again (`tend baseline render --write`)
body:
+ ci.contributors-only: Only a project open to contributions runs CI (it declares itself open, and its repo is public): on others' pull requests, and on its release tags when others build on its releases, on GitHub's hosted runners. Every other project has no workflows and GitHub Actions turned off; its checks run locally before every commit (the pre-commit hook, `tend code hook --install`). Projects are closed unless they say otherwise, and none is open yet.
~ rust.ci-reads-toolchain: Where a project runs CI, it takes the toolchain from rust-toolchain.toml (rustup reads it when cargo runs); a workflow never pins a second version beside it, except a nightly where only nightly will do (Miri, fuzzing).
~ rust.clippy-clean: Code is clippy-clean with warnings denied (cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings), under every feature set the project builds.
- ci.on-demand
- ci.private-deps
scaffold deny.toml changed
guidance changed
